sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above)

control_flow: Forever: avoidWalls: if the light is below 70 %, look at the obstacle sensors on the left and right, else go to driveInTheDark.
In dim light: a wall on the left turns it left 20°, a wall on the right turns it right 20°, otherwise it goes to driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the light is below 70 % it drives forward at 30 % without end, else it goes to stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead it stops, else it goes to followLine.
followLine: on black it curves left, otherwise it curves right.

likely_intent.description: Inside a dark tunnel, turn away from a wall close on its left or right, and get through a bending tunnel without touching it.
